statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome
The service was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service was ordered to guide further management of the dual rhythm disturbance
The diagnoses are I48.0 and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
